messages:
Priya: Heads-up team — final "last-mile" SEO checklist for the launch posts + webinar page. Need: keyword priorities, canonical decisions, JSON-LD for webinar & FAQ, internal anchor plan, and a redirect matrix. Who can own the redirect sheet?
Dan: I can own the redirect sheet. Share the legacy-URL export and the preferred targets. I'll label each as 301/302.
Hugo: I'll build the JSON-LD bundle. Suggest Event + FAQ + Organization snippets on the webinar landing.
Lisa: Anchor strategy idea: top-of-funnel blog -> pillar guide -> webinar signups. Use consistent anchor copy: "see benchmark results" for webinar links.
Ben: Quick Q: for content variants we're A/Bing, do we canonicalize to the control or leave as self-canonical?
Priya: If variant is temporary, canonicalize to variant and use 302. If variant will be folded into a canonical post, point canonical to the final long-form. We'll mark that in the spreadsheet.
Dan: Putting a small nginx rule sample in case ops needs it:
```
# redirect rules (ops PR will include full list)
location /old-case-study {
  return 301 https://redwood.ai/resources/case-study;
}
location /experiment/x-variant {
  return 302 https://redwood.ai/experiment/x;
}
```
Hugo: Draft Event JSON-LD (compressed) to paste into head:
```
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Product Launch Webinar","startDate":"2025-07-21T18:00:00Z","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinar/launch-2025"}
```
Hugo: And a short FAQ snippet sample:
```
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"FAQPage","mainEntity":[{"@type":"Question","name":"What will the webinar cover?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Benchmarks, cost optimizations, and migration tips."}}]}
```
Lisa: Small UX note — make sure the webinar CTA uses the same ID across pages to enable JS scroll-to-anchor behavior and consistent fragment anchors for analytics.
Ben: I'm preparing the inbound-routing piece: route demo signups with utm_source=webinar to sales-funnel-B, otherwise to nurture. Snippet: 
```
if utm_source == 'webinar': post -> sales-funnel-B
else: post -> nurture-logic
```
seo-bot: quick crawl summary: found 9 legacy URLs with backlinks (priority high), 4 tag hubs with thin content, 6 orphaned internal pages. Flags: /legacy/case-2018, /alpha/docs-old, /tag/python-old.
Priya: Dan -> prioritize the 9 backlinked legacy pages for 301s to preserve equity. Tag hubs need content merges before we push canonical changes.
Dan: Will build the mapping and submit PR to infra by EOD. I'll include a column for reason (backlink, low-traffic, experimental) and recommended redirect type.
Hugo: One more schema note — keep event name identical to the <title> and canonical to avoid GSC mismatch warnings. I'll align strings with the canonical titles doc.
Lisa: I'll publish the anchor map in the shared doc and add example CTAs and their UTM templates.
Ben: After redirects are merged, I'll smoke test the signup flow in staging and report post-deploy.
Priya: Action items recap: Dan -> redirect matrix + PR; Hugo -> JSON-LD bundle + FAQ variants; Lisa -> anchor/CTA map + UTM patterns; Ben -> routing rules + staging tests. Meeting to verify at 11:00 PT tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Dan: on it, starting URL mapping now.
Hugo: posting schema snippets to the launch doc in 20m.
seo-bot: sitemap ping scheduled at 1779000600; will post ping result when done.
Priya: Thanks all — keep updates in this thread if you hit blockers.
